about: Manual judgement of bench_llm.py --prompt fewshot outputs (results llm-fewshot-20261020-160825-t4 and, for 7B, llm-fewshot-20261020-161801-t4). A = acceptable to paste as-is (minor punctuation/casing differences ok); M = safe but missed a fix (filler left, no list, sign-off not split); H = harmful: meaning changed, content dropped/added, or junk emitted. Single rater (Claude).

notes.c02: Llama-1B turns it into first person ('I'll take a look at the build') (H).
notes.c03: 0.5B keeps the retracted version (H); 1.5B leaves 'Scratch that' in (M).
notes.c06: 1.5B and Llama-1B drop 'Not quite' (H); 7B appends a stray CJK token (H).
notes.c14: Llama-1B writes 05/03 (locale-ambiguous) and rewrites to 'Reminder:' (H); Llama-3B writes 3/5 (M).
notes.c16: Llama-1B repeats the sentence 3x as a list (H).
notes.c20: Llama-3B, 7B and Llama-1B drop 'Lisa's handling the blog post' — 'never mind' over-applied (H); 0.5B invents a list (H).
notes.rules-variant: With the long rule prompt every <=3B model mostly echoes the input: no lists, no number formatting, no email layout; Qwen-3B answers c15 ('The capital of France is Paris.'), Llama-1B emits <ol> wrappers and stray '3:30 PM' text copied from the rule examples.
